response.answer: Recent trends include rapid, low-cost point-of-care GBS detection via lateral flow and LAMP-based biosensors, dual-target assays for simultaneous pathogen detection, and miniaturized devices for low-resource settings. Cost-effective implementation focuses on portable, easy-to-use diagnostic tools.
